"""Try to build a large minimal DFA (near the product cap) and time it."""
import importlib.util
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mainmod", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

rng = random.Random(4)
alphabet = ["a", "b", "c"]
best = None
for trial in range(400):
    atoms = []
    for i in range(10):
        op = "endswith" if trial % 2 == 0 else "contains"
        atoms.append((op, [rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(16)]))
    req = {"services": alphabet,
           "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [
               {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": op, "path": p}} for op, p in atoms]}}],
           "queries": []}
    payload = (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    el = time.time() - t0
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    if not out.get("ok"):
        continue
    size = len(out["dfa"]["accept"])
    if best is None or size > best[0]:
        best = (size, el, len(p.stdout), payload)
        print("new best: states=%d time=%.2fs bytes=%d" % (size, el, len(p.stdout)))
    if el > 1.0:
        print("slow trial: states=%d time=%.2fs" % (size, el))
print("BEST states=%d time=%.2fs bytes=%d" % (best[0], best[1], best[2]))
PYEOF
